sources.title: PhonePe Pulse — Metric definitions
sources.supports: Registered users are cumulative unique PhonePe Group sign-ups; Tier 2+ means outside Tier 1 under RBI classification and 2011 Census data, not a rural classification. Merchants are cumulative onboarded merchants.

sources.title: Best Payment App for Teens: How Paytm Pocket Money is Changing the Way Teenagers Pay in India
sources.supports: Official article dated 29 September 2026 advertises Pocket Money to teenagers and parents, using UPI Circle with parent-controlled spending.

items.text: Paytm markets Pocket Money to teenagers, with spending limits and payment access controlled by a parent or trusted family member.
Pocket Money lets parents and trusted family members invite teenagers, manage allowances and review payments.
Paytm’s general terms require age 18 or older; Pocket Money is advertised separately as a supervised teen feature.
Minors may access the platform with a parent’s permission and supervision; the terms say parents or guardians must make their transactions.

CRED terms require age 21+ for users joining from 1 October 2023; earlier members had to be 18+ when joining.
